intent: Reconcile authorized prospect, account, and client-deliverable evidence through one bounded client-service route.
successCondition: The smallest sufficient route produces one evidence-traceable artifact without implying regulated, external, or background authority.

direct: assess a prospect and preserve evidence coverage
reconcile account operations into a bounded state contract
turn verified client findings into a proposal or report
paraphrased: build traceable client-service artifacts from our authorized records
shape prospect findings and account state into bounded delivery work
transform agency evidence into an assessment operational view or client deliverable
contextual: client records and deliverables disagree about what the evidence supports
several agency stages need one governed evidence trail without external action
the opportunity pipeline needs clear confidence account state and next artifacts

negativeIntents: routine lookup status edit or copy change
unauthorized external communication or account mutation
